correctness.rationale: Unrolling the rank recurrence through level three is exact. For triangle-free pairs, a nonedge admits four signatures and an edge only three. Fullness of a nonedge pair provides three witnesses realizing the edge-pair signatures automatically via triangle exclusion. Four distinct forced edges and four distinct external pattern witnesses give the six-vertex, four-edge lower bounds and unique sparsity equality. On six vertices the only optional edges are ab,ad,bd,cd, and only the triangle ab-ad-bd is excluded; 14 rooted templates therefore exhaust all shapes. The included standalone checker exhausts all 32768 six-vertex labelled graphs and separately expands the 14 templates under all 720 relabellings. Both yield 2292 labelled / 9 isomorphism classes with edge distribution 360,792,780,360, and the proof establishes the all-order claim independently of the finite census. Quantifiers cover all finite or countable K3-free hosts; no rank-four claim is made.

value.rationale: Clique-free ages are explicitly outside the full-extension-property mechanism in the 2026 rank framework, giving an actual structural gap. The theorem resolves the first nontrivial relative-rank boundary in the Henson graph age by a six-vertex, nine-shape forbidden induced-subgraph characterization valid at every host order. A uniquely sharp four-edge extremum, all six-vertex equality profiles and an exact 2292-labelled census supply non-implied structural and enumerative content. This is a complete natural hereditary boundary and a reusable fixed-witness criterion, not an arbitrary slice or a claim of general rank-property resolution.
